champions_subtitle: Pick a champion, a skin and build a loadout
champions_pool_hint: Click a card to add it to your loadout
library_about_instances: An instance is one patch of Paladins with its own mods and settings. Keep as many side by side as you like.
library_download_patch_hint: Pick any patch and Tempest downloads it for you.
library_import_folder_hint: Add a Paladins install you already have. Tempest detects its patch.
library_arrange_patch_hint: By game version, closed beta at the top
library_arrange_patch_desc_hint: By game version, latest at the top
library_arrange_note: The sidebar follows this order too.
downloads_empty_hint: Patches you download and installs you verify line up here and run one at a time.
downloads_graph_label: Download speed over the last two minutes, peaking at {speed}
error_page_description: An unexpected error crashed the launcher. Reloading usually fixes it.
error_404_description: This page doesn't exist. Head back home to keep going.
error_section_description: Something went wrong while rendering this view. The rest of the launcher keeps running.
serverlist_experimental_warning: This feature is experimental and only 0.57 is currently supported.
serverlist_no_servers_hint: Host a server or try refreshing the list
serverlist_no_servers_matching_hint: Try a different search term or clear the filter
serverlist_error_fetching: Error while fetching the server list.
lobby_kicked_hint: You have been removed from the lobby by the server.
lobby_reconnecting: Unable to connect to the lobby server. Reconnecting...
settings_cli_description: Installs the Tempest CLI so you can run `tempest <command>` in a terminal — mod management, instance setup and debugging. The command is installed next to the launcher and added to your PATH. On macOS this may ask for administrator permission to install into /usr/local/bin.
settings_cli_not_on_path: Not on PATH yet: open a new terminal, or add the folder above to PATH.
settings_cli_installed_toast: The tempest CLI is ready. Open a new terminal and run `tempest --help`.
onboarding_download_description: Download the 0.57 build and enable multiplayer automatically.
onboarding_install_error: The download could not be started. Try again or skip onboarding.
onboarding_done_description: Your setup is ready. You can change your username, runtime and games anytime from Settings.
onboarding_summary_none: Skipped. Add one from the Library later.
settings_seasonal_effects_hint: Animations that match the time of year
settings_mod_developer_description: Enables mod development tools, such as the Cook Mod converter.
settings_open_ssl_fix_description: Prevents AVX-512 crashes on 10th/11th/12th Gen Intel CPUs by masking the OpenSSL ICAPIcap bit
settings_onboarding_description: Walk through the first-time setup again: language, username, game import and download.
settings_reset_warning: Puts every setting back to its default and empties your library. Game folders and their mods stay on disk.
settings_clear_all_confirm_text: Every setting goes back to its default and your library is emptied. Game folders and their mods stay on disk, so you can import them again. This cannot be undone.
settings_error_boundary_description: Dev-only. Crashes this page to test the error boundary and its recovery UI.
settings_feature_flags_description: Dev-only. Toggle feature flags to test upcoming functionality.
settings_feature_flags_console_hint: For advanced control, open the developer console and use __flags.enable('name'), __flags.disable('name'), __flags.set('name', value), etc.
terminal_command_placeholder: Type a server command and press Enter
wizard_description: One patch of Paladins with its own mods and settings.
wizard_installs_copy_to: You already have this patch, so this copy installs to {path}
wizard_game_folder_hint: Browse can pick several folders to import them at once.
wizard_found_scanning: Looking through Steam, Epic Games, Hi-Rez and your drives…
wizard_found_none: No Paladins install turned up. Add its folder below.
wizard_found_failed: Couldn't look for Paladins on this PC. Add its folder below.
wizard_import_footer: The files stay where they are.
wizard_depot_downloader_hint: Fetches the same files from Steam with your own account. Import the folder once it's done.
wizard_could_not_identify: This folder doesn't look like a Paladins installation.
wizard_identify_error: An error occurred during build identification.
wizard_build_not_in_database: Build identified as {patchName} ({versionGroup}), but it's not in our database.
wizard_unknown_build: Unrecognised Paladins build, so its game version couldn't be detected.
wizard_login_prompt_desc: 8.1 is the live game and needs your account
delete_type_name: Type its name to delete the files
delete_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
delete_from_disk_hint: Removes all game files from your computer
delete_option_library_hint: The game folder and its mods stay on disk.
delete_option_library_mods: Remove from library and uninstall mods
delete_option_library_mods_hint: The game stays on disk, without its mods.
delete_option_delete_hint: Deletes the whole game folder from disk. This cannot be undone.
hostserver_public_hint: Public servers are visible on the server list
hostserver_port_conflict_message: A server you're hosting is already running on port {port}. Close it and start the new server?
hostserver_upnp_hint: Automatically open ports on your router
instance_add_mods_hint: Add mods to customize your instance
instance_drag_import_hint: Drag and drop .tempest files here, or click below to import.
instance_add_mod_tile: Drop a mod file here, or click to add one
instance_version_unknown: Not a patch Tempest knows, so its files can't be verified.
instance_space_separated: Passed to the game on every launch, separated by spaces.
instance_setup_hint: Reinstalls the bundled mod and rebuilds the game data Tempest needs to launch it.
instance_verify_hint: Checks every file against the patch's download and fetches what is missing or damaged.
instance_verify_unknown: Needs a known game version to check the files against.
instance_remove_hint: Takes the instance out of your library. Next you choose whether its mods or its whole game folder go too.
instance_autosave: Changes save as you make them
instance_presets_hint: Preset arguments run before the instance's own launch arguments.
mod_no_files: No files updated by this mod.
mod_details_no_readme: No readme provided for this mod.
mod_details_file_truncated: … truncated (file too large, showing first 50k chars)
home_another_patch: Play another patch side by side, with its own mods.
home_feed_unavailable: Unable to load the blog feed.
home_discord_hint: Chat with other players and modders.
home_docs_hint: Guides to playing and modding with Tempest.
home_quip_running_1: You're in a match right now. Why are you reading this?
home_quip_running_3: Your team is asking where you went.

match.yearsPlural=one: {patch} came out a year ago today. Happy birthday, old friend.
match.yearsPlural=other: {patch} came out {years} years ago today. Happy birthday, old friend.

home_quip_long_absence: Long time no see. The payload missed you.
home_quip_days_away: {days} days since your last match. Your mods have been very patient.
home_quip_never_played: {name} is installed and has never seen a match. Tragic.
home_quip_collector: {count} patches installed. At this point it's a museum.
home_quip_downloading: A patch is downloading. Perfect time to stretch.
home_quip_no_instances: No patches yet. Bold move, opening a launcher.
home_quip_default_name: Still going by “Player”? You can change that in Settings.
home_quip_late_1: It's {time}. One more match won't hurt. (It will.)
home_quip_late_2: The payload never sleeps. You should, though.
home_quip_monday: Monday. A quick match before work counts as warming up.
home_quip_friday: Friday night. One more match is a perfectly reasonable plan.
home_quip_2: Somewhere, a Grover is still waiting for heals.
home_quip_3: Some walls are heavy. We checked.
home_quip_4: Today's forecast: scattered Bomb King laughter.
home_quip_5: Stand on the point. All of you.
home_quip_6: Your flank will wait. Your support won't.
home_quip_7: Every patch is somebody's favorite patch.
home_quip_8: Tempest has never lost a team fight. It has also never been in one.
home_quip_10: Some say the old codes still work. ↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ …
home_quip_winter_1: Snow is falling on Frozen Guard. Probably.
home_quip_winter_3: Dear Santa, all I want is a healer who heals.
home_quip_winter_4: Even Evie put on a scarf today.
home_quip_christmas_1: Your present this year: zero queue times.
home_quip_christmas_2: Ho ho ho. Oh, that's just Bomb King.
home_quip_christmas_3: Santa skipped your house. You were on flank.
home_quip_nye_1: One last match before midnight. Make it count.
home_quip_halloween_1: Boo! Sorry. Ying's illusions made us do it.
home_quip_halloween_2: The scariest thing this October is still a Strix on high ground.
home_quip_halloween_3: Something is lurking in the jungle. It's a Mal'Damba. It's always a Mal'Damba.
home_quip_april_2: All mods now cost 400 crystals. (They don't.)
home_quip_autumn_1: The leaves are falling. So is your team's morale.
home_quip_autumn_3: Cozy season. Perfect for a long siege.
home_quip_rerolls: That's enough quips for now. Go play.
home_quip_prize: Fine, you win. Here's your prize.
toast_unsupported_file_message: Only .upk .pck and .tempest mod files are supported.
conflict_mod_message: A mod named {name} is already installed on this instance.
conflict_overwrite_warning: Do you want to overwrite it with the new file? This will replace the files in your game directory.
conflict_header_subtitle: These modify the same game files
conflict_same_mod_subtitle: A mod with this ID is already installed.
unverified_mod_message: The mod "{name}" contains code (DLLs or Lua scripts) that is signed, but not by a trusted source.
unverified_mod_warning: Code from an untrusted source has full access to your system and could be harmful. Only install it if you trust its author. Are you sure you want to install it anyway?
unverified_mod_key_list_offline: Tempest couldn't reach its list of trusted keys, so only the built-in keys are trusted for now. A mod from a trusted author can show this warning until the list is reachable again.
select_instance_hint: Please select which Paladins instance you want to install this mod to:
select_instance_no_instances: No prepared instances found. Please create or finish setting up an instance first.
select_instance_incompatible_hint: {name} {version} is made for patch {compat}, but this instance is on {patch}. Choose an instance on a supported patch:
select_instance_compat_hint: {name} {version} is made for patch {compat}. Choose an instance to install it to:
overlay_drop_here: Drop the mod file {upk} or {pck} here to install onto this instance.
lobby_no_valid_instance: No valid instance found for version {version}
lobby_no_valid_instance_hint: Please leave the lobby and install the correct game version
settings_wine_gamescope_not_installed: Gamescope was not found in PATH. Install it to enable this option.
settings_wine_steam_runtime_description: Run Proton inside Steam's Linux Runtime (pressure-vessel) when a compatible one is found.
settings_keybinds_description: Set your in-game keybinds once here. They will be written into every instance's config file.
settings_keybinds_unsaved: Changes are applied to instances the next time you launch.
settings_keybinds_mod_hint: Or package them as a mod to share them or to install them into a single instance.
updater_uptodate_desc: Tempest Launcher is on the latest version.
updater_available_desc_win: A new version of Tempest is ready to download.
updater_available_desc_other: A new version of Tempest is available. Please install the update from your package provider.
updater_relaunching_desc: The launcher is restarting to apply the update.
converter_subtitle: Build a V2 mod package and sign it
converter_drop_more: Drop more files here, or click to pick them
converter_mod_id_hint: Permanent, lowercase identifier the repository and updates use
converter_mod_id_invalid: Use 2-64 lowercase letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or number
converter_summary_placeholder: One line shown in the repository listing
converter_signing_key_hint: Mods are signed so players know who made them. This name travels with every mod you publish — use your handle or email.
converter_signing_key_cancelled: Cooking needs a signing key — cook again and choose a name
cooker_onboarding_intro: Turn old mods into signed, publishable packages — or build new ones from loose files. Two quick setup steps, once.
cooker_onboarding_key_hint: Mods are signed so players know who made them. This name travels with every mod you publish — use your handle or email.
cooker_onboarding_key_ready: Signing key ready — the cooker will use this one
cooker_onboarding_api_hint: To publish straight from the launcher, paste the API key from the website (Settings → API keys). You can also skip this and upload the cooked file manually.
cooker_onboarding_done_text: You can cook mods now. Publishing works without any of this too — the finished file is yours to upload wherever you like.
converter_publish_manual: Your package is ready to upload — grab it with Download above, then upload it on the website.
settings_signing_key_hint: Mods you cook are signed with this key so players can tell who made them. It never leaves this machine.
settings_signing_key_none: No signing key on this machine yet
settings_signing_key_replace_hint: Replacing it only changes future mods — already published versions keep the old signature.
settings_signing_key_verify_hint: Paste the verification text from your account page on the mod repository website, sign it here, then paste the signature back on that page to prove you own this key.
settings_signing_key_verify_text_placeho: Verification text from your account page
settings_signing_key_verify_copied_messa: Paste it back on your account page to verify your key.
settings_api_key_hint: Lets the launcher publish mods for you. Create one on the mod website under Settings → API keys.
converter_compat_hint: Comma-separated Paladins patch numbers, or a range below
converter_compat_required: Declare at least one compatible patch or range
converter_summary_required: A summary is required for a new mod
converter_publish_queued: Queued for moderation — the dashboard shows the outcome
converter_login_title: Sign in to the mod repository
converter_login_hint: Create an API key on the website under Settings, then paste it here
converter_toast_published_message: {id} v{version} is on its way to the repository
converter_version_invalid: Use a semantic version: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, like 1.0.0 or 1.2.0-beta.1
converter_mod_id_invalid_title: "{id}" can't be used as a mod ID
converter_files_hint: A .tempest package also fills in its name, version, authors, readme and icon.
converter_no_files: There are no files in it to cook.
converter_cooked_stale_hint: Cook again to put the changes into the package.
converter_listing_hint: Shown on the mod repository when you publish.
batch_tempest_only: Batch mode converts .tempest packages — use Single Mod for loose .upk, .pck, .ini, .dll or .lua files
legacy_found_desc: Tempest Launcher now uses a new installer. Your settings, instances and mods were migrated automatically, so nothing was lost.
legacy_found_body: A previous install of Tempest Launcher was found on this computer:
legacy_cancelled: Removal was cancelled. You can try again.
legacy_remove_failed: Couldn't remove the old version automatically ({code}). Uninstall it from Windows Settings → Apps instead.
antivirus_desc: Windows Security blocked the files Tempest uses to load mod code into the game, so DLL and script mods can't load.
antivirus_stopped: The game was closed so it doesn't run with your mods missing.
antivirus_body: Tempest's injector looks like malware to antivirus heuristics, but it only loads your installed mods. Excluding these folders lets it run:
antivirus_note: If a mod's DLL was removed, reinstall that mod or restore it from Protection history.
antivirus_cancelled: Administrator permission was declined. You can try again.
antivirus_failed_hint: If you use another antivirus, add the folders in its settings instead.
repo_kind_assets_hint: Textures, sounds, UPK and config files. Installs without review.
repo_kind_scripts_hint: Lua scripts for the Tempest scripting runtime. Reviewed before publishing.
repo_kind_native_hint: Contains a DLL injected into the game. Reviewed before publishing.
repo_close_game_first: Close the game to install mods
repo_trust_official_hint: Made and signed by the Tempest team.
repo_trust_signed_hint: Signed by {name}, a key that is not verified yet. Assets only: textures, sounds and config. Nothing runs code.
repo_trust_reviewed_hint: Signed by {name}. Moderators reviewed the code, the key is not verified yet.
repo_trust_revoked_hint: The signing key was revoked. Do not install.
repo_trust_unsigned_hint: Assets only: textures, sounds and config. Nothing runs code.
repo_unreachable: The mod repository could not be reached.
repo_installed_revoked: This version was revoked by the repository
repo_updates_description: New versions of installed mods are published on the mod repository. Update now or later from the Mods tab.
repo_bug_body_placeholder: What went wrong, what you did before it, anything the author needs to reproduce it
repo_bug_anonymous: Anonymous. The report opens a thread on our Discord.
repo_bug_failed: The report could not be sent. The mod repository may be unreachable.
repo_bug_sent_description: A thread is open in our Discord with your report already in it — reply there to keep talking to the author.
deps_dialog_message: Install them along with the mod? They go in first so the mod works right away. Installing only the mod leaves it without them until you add them from its row in the list.
deps_needs_tempest: needs Tempest {requirement}; this is {version}. Update Tempest first.
deps_unresolved: needs {id} ({requirement}), which the repository could not provide.
mod_missing_dependencies_hint: Not installed or enabled at a version this mod accepts. Click to install from the repository.
converter_dependencies_hint: One per line: a mod id and an optional version requirement (>=1.0.0, ^1.2). "tempest" is the launcher itself. The launcher installs these alongside the mod.
